label: Coinbase Exchange
terms_note: Public market-data endpoints only (no key). HTML docs; the only spec link the docs page carries belongs to another product (Deribit app), so the mapping comes from the HTML reference. Public endpoints are rate-limited per IP (docs: 10 requests per second, bursts to 15). Candle rows are [time, LOW, HIGH, OPEN, CLOSE, volume] newest first, at most 300; granularity must be 60, 300, 900, 3600, 21600 or 86400 (400 'Unsupported granularity' otherwise). The ticker does not repeat the product id. Unknown product: 404 {"message":"NotFound"} (live 2026-10-01).

list_markets.note: Every product including delisted ones (type = status: online, delisted ...); paged locally.

get_candles.note: interval: 1m 5m 15m 1h 6h 1d. Newest first; up to 300 per call; the newest `limit` are returned.

not_offered.me: Private endpoints need CB-ACCESS-KEY, an HMAC-SHA256 CB-ACCESS-SIGN and a passphrase; public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_balances: GET /accounts needs an API key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /orders needs an API key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /orders needs an API key and spends money; not mapped.
not_offered.cancel_order: DELETE /orders/{order_id} needs an API key; not mapped.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
